items: An AI agent goes beyond a simple chatbot because it can take action, such as taking an order, booking a table, sending a follow-up or flagging an unhappy guest.
Start with one repetitive task, like answering guest questions, handling reservations or replying to reviews, and pick an agent that fits your main guest channels.
Give the agent your menu, hours, policies and FAQs, set clear rules for when it hands a conversation to staff, and test it before guests see it.
Momos brings reviews and messages into one Unified Inbox, where its Alfie AI agent drafts on-brand replies and Rockie surfaces trends by location.
After launch, track results and keep adjusting the agent as you learn which answers and handoffs work.
